issues: 168px 常规字重灰字在浅灰底上，字重变化幅度小，缩略图上几乎看不出在"泵"
五拍从头到尾一样强，没有递进也没有高潮，结尾回到原样
节拍参照是 5 个 16px 小圆点，静帧里读不出"在跟拍"
画面只有一行字，没有舞台、光和品牌信息
changes: look 换成 aurora 夜店海报：深紫夜 + 紫粉霓虹，240px「LOUDER」，字后柔光随拍明暗（不做整画面逐拍泵）
字重幅度拉满且换了排法：每个字钉在 900 字重的槽位里，静止是 250 细体、字间留缝，鼓点一到笔画撑满槽位"合拢"，再按中间先收、两边后收（9→13f）弹回
节奏改为 128 BPM 两小节 + drop：第 1 小节只有主字脉冲；第 2 小节上下长出描边回声行，晚 2f 跟拍并被推开（跟随）；第 9 拍 drop 冲到 900 后定格在 780 字重 + 紫→粉渐变 + 一道横向光带
每小节第 1 拍重音：scaleX +6% 并染粉；参照物改成 8+1 格步进音序器（含 DROP 格），亮哪格 = 第几拍
补全版式：PULSE AUDIO 眉题、128 BPM / BAR n/2 读数、drop 后 40px 副标题逐词升起，时长 165f，尾帧是完整海报
issuesEn: 168px regular-weight grey text on light grey; the weight swing was small and barely visible in thumbnails
All five beats hit equally hard with no build or climax, and it ended where it started
The beat reference was five 16px dots that did not read as following a beat in a still
One line of text with no stage, light or brand context
changesEn: Aurora club-poster look: deep violet night with violet-pink neon, a 240px LOUDER, and a glow behind it that pulses with the beat (no full-frame pumping)

Full weight range with a new layout: every letter sits in a slot sized for weight 900, so at rest the 250-weight letters leave gaps and each kick fills the slots shut, then releases centre-first with edges trailing (9→13f)

128 BPM, two bars plus a drop: bar 1 pumps the word alone; in bar 2 outlined echo rows grow above and below, follow 2f late and get pushed apart; beat 9 drops to weight 900 and settles at 780 with a violet-to-pink gradient and one horizontal light streak
Each bar's downbeat is accented with +6% scaleX and a pink tint; the reference is now an 8+1 step sequencer with a DROP pad that lights the current beat
Complete layout: PULSE AUDIO kicker, 128 BPM / BAR n/2 readout, and a 40px tagline that rises after the drop; 165f, ending on a finished poster
